published_title: Feels Like I'm Profiting for the First Time
description: First serious attempt at a Profit deck.
strategy:
Very briefly, here are some reasons for specific cards. I will be replacing the Han (V) with another Han With Blaster Rifle ASAP

I am thinking of starting Insurrection (will also be replaced with the combo ASAP)in place of Colo Claw Fish, what do you guys think?

The Camp - aliens deploy +1 to Tat, +2 to same site as Jedi...me like

As far as sites go I was also thinking of putting in a Spaceport: Docking Bay, for use at Jabba's Palace, again opionins welcomed

Characters are pretty straight forward. The Quiggy, JM will be replaced ASAP with a Quiggy.

Skiff - for reacting of course

Leia's Blaster Rifle - any targets hit = lost. My kind of gun.

Frozen Assets - to help free Han if things go to s*** (Rebels deploy -2 and power +2)and I can't get Leia as fast as I would like.

Tunnel Vision - to find those much needed cards that always end up in your Force Pile.

OOC/TT - to get rid of that pesky interrupt when you verify your opponents deck (remember they too suffer from the OMG its in my Force Pile syndrome).

All comments (good or bad) are welcomed and appreciated.
